But email all trainers at once from website is a need/capability. "from the website" not concrete UI. No violation.

In QUS, problem-oriented violation if "prescribes concrete UI widgets, technical mechanisms, implementation details, algorithms, storage formats, or other solution choices instead of stakeholder need." "very clear map" is perhaps solution (map). But is map necessary? For navigation to rooms, map is a solution. Could be violation? We need consistent.
